targets.authors: May AC, Burrows K, Figueroa-Hall LK, Kirlic N, White EJ, Smith R, Ekhtiari H, Paulus MP, Savitz J, Stewart JL
targets.title: Sex differences in circulating inflammatory mediators as a function of substance use disorder.
targets.evidence_quote: To increase confidence that our initial SUD findings were reliable, this project (preregistered on https://aspredicted.org/ on 4/18/2023: “Inflammation as a function of substance use disorder” #129250) employed a subset of the second 550 Tulsa-1000 participants in an attempt to replicate lower CRP and higher IL-8 and IL-10 concentrations in females with SUD when compared to females without SUD.
targets.outcome_quote: In contrast to the replicated CRP findings in females, regression models for IL-8 and IL-10 did not replicate, although post-hoc analyses did show that SUD+ females again exhibited higher IL-8 concentrations than SUD− females when covariates were not included.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit contrast: CRP replicated, IL-8 and IL-10 omnibus models did not. Confirmation of the CRP finding is a specific comparison rather than an overall replication verdict.
